21646.description:
Pigeon Simulator is an absurd story about a pigeon forced to bring order to a world where common sense has long since evaporated. New Squawk City is teeming with oddities, and it is the avian government agents who keep the city from falling apart. Your duty is to fight chaos, achieve the impossible, and survive in a system that forbids mistakes.

Operation Wing

Work begins at sunrise and ends when you or the city ceases to exist. Flying microwaves, sentient packages, temporal distortions — it's all part of your daily routine. Use tools, create improvised traps, upgrade your gear, and monitor reports. The world is collapsing on schedule, and only discipline will save the feathered agents from being demoted to the trough.

Progression grants access to new devices, from anti-anomaly scanners to reactive waterers. Improve your reflexes, cooing, speed, and strength to become the perfect bird of justice. But remember: quotas are sacred. Fail, and you'll return to trash bags and rooftop life. The city needs heroes, even if they have feathers.

Features of the game

Dynamic missions to detect and neutralize anomalies. Absurd humor parodying secret services and the apocalypse. Pigeon Development System - From Street Agent to P.E.K. Elite A huge city with changing events and unpredictable threats.

21800.description:
Randomice is an adventure platformer where a mouse searches for freedom in a twisted house full of secrets and traps. The key feature is the random placement of objects, making each playthrough a constantly fresh experience. Each discovered tool unlocks unexpected possibilities and changes the escape strategy.

The explorer's instinct

The player must think on the fly: where to use a found item, how to exploit environmental features, and when a risk is justified. Magnetic hooks, rocket launchers, or improvised devices can become the key to a new section of the path. Mistakes cost time, but ingenuity opens new horizons.

The world is hand-drawn in soft pastel colors and filled with humor. Mice as companions offer advice, share their discoveries, and add warmth to the escape story. The variety of rooms and challenges makes the house a living labyrinth, where observation and ingenuity are more important than strength. Here, improvisation becomes an art, and chance an ally.

Features of the game

Metroidvania with elements of procedural route generation. Various items that affect the way you progress. Lively, hand-crafted visual style and fun characters. Escape mechanics with multiple route variations and solutions.

21888.description:
Lia: Hacking Destiny is a dynamic roguelite action game where the cyber-resistance wages its final battle against the machines. Fight soulless drones, hack their codes, and arm yourself with deadly devices to restore humanity's freedom. Each mission is a new chance to rewrite the algorithm of fate.

A world taken over by machines

Post-apocalyptic Earth has become an arena between reason and code. People are hiding, and cities have become AI laboratories. Leah, a talented hacker, can weaponize digital chaos. Swap weapons, create hybrid builds, and destroy the system from within. Your mind is the ultimate virus against the machine order.

Industrial complexes, abandoned factories, and twisted city ruins await you, where the strangest and most dangerous robots lurk. A mechanical "mother" guarding her drone babies and a crazed sheriff on a Segway are just the beginning. Use your wits, dexterity, and upgrades to prove that even a code can be cracked with the heart.

Features of the game

Fast-paced battles with elements of hacking and a build system. A variety of weapons and unique bonuses for combo attacks. Surreal bosses with individual mechanics. Cyberpunk atmosphere and resistance humor.

21921.description:
Log Away is a tranquil simulation of relaxation and creation, where every day is filled with warmth and light. Build cozy shelters, watch the seasons change, and listen to the whispers of nature, filling the world with your presence. There are no timers or rushing, only kindness, the sound of the wind, and a sense of home you'll want to return to.

A house where it's easy to breathe

Sea bays, forest glades, and mountain huts await you. Each place has its own rhythm, light, and mood. Decorate, arrange objects, collect stories from the past — softly spoken Memoirs bring back forgotten moments. Silence and comfort fill the space, and every detail brings the home to life.

This isn't just a game, but a form of peace. Here you can breathe, pause, and simply allow yourself to be. Your decisions shape the atmosphere, your interests color the surroundings, and every lamp and every detail holds a piece of your warmth. In this world, there are no victories or defeats — only harmony, breathing, and life.

Features of the game

A meditative construction simulator with hand-painted graphics and a soft atmosphere. A living world with dynamic weather and changing seasons. A collection of Memos – touching voiced stories from the past. A calming soundtrack and sounds of nature for complete immersion.

22218.description:
The Run is an interactive horror thriller featuring cutscenes, where every decision directly impacts the protagonist's fate. The story revolves around Zanna Hendricks, a world-famous fitness blogger whose outward confidence and success conceal a troubled past. A routine morning jog in the mountains of Northern Italy turns into a deadly hunt.

A run from which there is no escape

After several kilometers along a scenic route, Zanna becomes the target of a group of masked killers. The pursuit unfolds swiftly and mercilessly: forest paths, narrow passes, and secluded sections of the highway turn into traps. The intimate presentation through video sequences heightens the sense of presence, creating the feeling of truly participating in the unfolding nightmare.

The gameplay is built on constant choice. Decisions are made at critical moments — to run or hide, to trust instinct or take risks. Each choice can lead to salvation, a new threat, or one of many brutal deaths. The story responds to the player's actions, shaping different developmental paths and endings.

Features of the game

Interactive horror thriller with video inserts. Choice mechanics with consequences for the plot. 20 unique deaths and 5 different endings. Two modes: dynamic time selection and pause mode for streams.

22339.description:
Nothing Strange Here is an exploration adventure game where the player explores the open-world city of Larceny Gap, documenting events through photographs and notes. You navigate handcrafted locations, interact with residents, and complete quests, gradually uncovering hidden connections between events. Gameplay revolves around observation, information gathering, and influencing the world around you.

Research and interaction

The core mechanics focus on exploring the town and its inhabitants. The player photographs unusual scenes, records details in a journal, and helps residents solve their problems. Each quest unlocks new dialogues and events, building a general understanding of how Larsenest Gap is structured and the strange things that happen there.

After completing quests, the player chooses an article style, which influences the further development of the world. NPC dialogue, behavior, and the appearance of the environment are modified. The time of day also plays a role: some characters and events are only available during certain hours, encouraging repeated exploration of the city.

Features of the game

An open city with hand-created locations. Photography and journal as the main tools. Choosing an article style with impact on the world. Time system with unique events.

22735.description:
The Caribou Trail — is a first-person narrative adventure about friends from Newfoundland who set out for Gallipoli in 1915. They expected a short campaign, but instead found themselves in a world of raw earth, scorched slopes, and decisions that endure. At the center is not glory but endurance, not victory but the attempt to preserve humanity amid chaos.

Limit of endurance

Landing, advancing through trenches, sorties under fire — everything is experienced directly. You have to cut wire, make your way forward across broken ground, and eliminate threats that prevent you from holding your position. The cramped passages are oppressive, dust settles in your lungs, and the pauses before the order become a more intense ordeal than the battle itself.

Returning to camp brings no peace. Conversations around the campfire are muffled, laughter dies away sooner, and the shadows at the edges of the light seem all too clear. Superstition begins to seem more persuasive than common sense. The choice — to act decisively or to retreat — affects not the outcome of the campaign, but who one leaves behind.

Features of the game

A campaign covering the events of Gallipoli from the landing to the evacuation. Tactical sorties with different conditions for completing tasks. Focus on the atmosphere of trench warfare. A stylized visual presentation inspired by archival footage.

22977.description:
Mama's Sleeping Angels is a co-op adventure set in a Y2K aesthetic, where players find themselves inside the endless dream of the goddess Mama. Dream worlds are filled with strange creatures and forgotten souls that must be freed. To escape, players must explore dangerous spaces, collect cursed items, and return from the depths of the dream before Mama takes another life.

Exploring Nightmare Worlds

The journey takes place through procedurally generated dreamscapes, where rooms and landscapes change with each new attempt. Abandoned locations conceal strange entities and forgotten inhabitants. Some souls can be awakened, while others become a threat, making careful exploration the key to survival.

The exploration involves searching for cursed objects with unusual properties. Some enhance abilities, while others create dangerous effects. Using a flip phone, you can analyze the objects you find and discover their nature, gradually uncovering the secrets of this strange world and the reason for Mama's dream.

Features of the game

A co-op adventure for one to four players set in strange dream worlds. Procedurally generated locations with various creatures and dangers. Cursed items with unique effects and possible consequences. A variety of weapons to protect against monsters from the dream world.

23549.description:
Space Drilling Station — is a strategy game about managing a mining station on a distant planet, where everything comes down to limited space and constant pressure from the corporation. You're given a ten-level tower and tasked with squeezing it to the limit by extracting a rare resource and shipping it back to Earth. Mistakes in planning quickly become apparent, as space is tight, and demands only mount.

Little space, many tasks

Every floor must be used wisely. Production, housing, and maintenance all compete for space, and any poor decision begins to interfere with the entire station's operations. The structure must be constantly restructured to maintain efficiency. Simply expanding won't work; the precise arrangement and interaction of all elements is crucial.

Employees also play a role. They need to be assigned tasks, monitored, and avoided from burning out. If their status is ignored, productivity drops, and the station begins to fall behind schedule. Ultimately, the game hinges on a balance between process automation and control over those who support the system.

Features of the game

Station control in a confined space. Planning of floors and production chains. Working with personnel and their condition. Pressure from corporations and quotas.

23703.description:
Leafy Corner is a cozy plant store management simulator where you grow, care for, and sell houseplants, gradually expanding your space. The focus is on plant care and customer service, where it's important not just to sell a product but to find the right one for your needs.

Care and selection of plants

Plants grow gradually, changing over time, so they need to be monitored and brought to the desired condition before sale. Leaves don't open immediately, and the result depends on how you care for each plant. Buyers come with various requests, sometimes quite unusual ones, and you have to select options that truly suit them, rather than simply handing over the first one you see.

The store also evolves through its design. Shelves, pots, and decor are revealed as you progress, allowing you to assemble the space to suit your taste. Colors, arrangements, and details create the feeling of a vibrant space you'll want to linger in. Over time, more options and variety become available, and the store begins to look exactly how you envisioned it.

Features of the game

Growing and caring for indoor plants. Selection of plants according to customer requests. Store design and development. Discovery of new plant species and varieties.

23824.description:
FLAW It's a retro shooter in the vein of Unreal, Half-Life, and old Halo, where instead of heroically saving the world, you're simply thrown into a prison complex on some dead planet and left to die. The protagonist was flying a colony ship in search of a normal life, but it all ends with him being boarded, kidnapped, and waking up among iron corridors, corpses, and creatures that clearly don't care whether you make it out or not.

I'm running out of ammo faster than I'd like.

You have to scavenge weapons from enemies and constantly consider whether it's worth wasting your ammunition on the next creature ahead. The corridors are full of both living enemies and something long rotted but still dangerous. Some rooms resemble a meat grinder, others an abandoned industrial hell with a multitude of passages, vents, and cramped metal compartments, where any skirmish quickly descends into chaos.

Along the way, they encounter surviving passengers and crew members of the Burning Dawn. Most of them are ordinary civilians with no training, but even they can help them escape or at least prevent them from dying in this place. Gradually, the story begins to unravel the theme of abductions and what's happening on this planet in general, because the prison turns out to be far from the most terrifying part of the story.

Features of the game

A retro shooter in the spirit of Unreal and Half-Life. Dark sci-fi atmosphere and prison complex. Limited ammo and weapons from enemies. Rescue of the ship's surviving passengers.

24638.description:
Kinny and the Cosmic Cauldron is an arcade game about space cuisine, where deck-building strategy meets chaotic cooking. Cook fantastical stews, experiment with unusual ingredients, and prove to the galaxy's most discerning creatures that your cuisine is worthy of legendary status.

Cauldron of the Universe

Cooking revolves around constantly changing conditions. Ingredients don't just fall into a cauldron — they interact with each other, collide, activate various properties, and create unexpected combinations. To achieve great results, you need to carefully select your deck, consider the properties of each component, and use the resulting synergies to your advantage.

As you progress, new upgrades are unlocked, expanding the cauldron's capabilities and allowing you to cook even more efficiently. Obtaining relics changes the familiar rules, and the ever-increasing difficulty forces you to seek out ever more effective strategies. The unique pixel art style, quirky guests, and atmosphere of cosmic madness make each cooking session completely different from the last.

Features of the game

An unusual mix of cooking, roguelike, and deckbuilding. Dynamic interactions of ingredients in the cauldron. Upgrade system and collection of unique relics. A colorful pixel world with alien guests.

24759.description:
Welcome to Elderfield is a cozy horror RPG about life in a small, strange town, where mundane activities gradually intertwine with unexplained events and ancient horrors. Decorate your home, meet the locals, grow unusual crops, explore mines and forests, and try to understand why Starodol is becoming an increasingly unsettling place for a peaceful life.

A cozy life amidst strange events

Spend your days doing the usual things: farming, fishing, mining, and exploring the city's surroundings. Develop relationships with unusual residents, learn their stories, make friends, or start a family. Furnish your own home and gradually unlock new opportunities, as you watch the secrets of Starodol and the ancient powers lurking nearby unfold beneath the quiet, everyday life.

The farm isn't without its oddities either. Grow corn, pumpkins, teeth, and eyeballs, raise otherworldly creatures, and defend your domain from creatures that might emerge from the forest. A deep turn-based combat system is available for clashes with dangerous enemies: use collected resources, select equipment, apply strategic buffs, and decide how much of a challenge you're willing to take on.

Features of the game
A cozy horror RPG with life simulator elements. Farming, fishing, mining and free exploration of Starodol. Developing relationships with locals, friendship and the possibility of marriage. Unusual cultures, otherworldly creatures and turn-based battles.
